_comment: Mutation testing on the trust-critical modules (issue #187, part of #178). Diff-coverage proves changed lines EXECUTE; mutation testing proves the tests would CATCH a bug. Scope is deliberately limited to the highest-stakes pure logic: trust derivations (app/trust), the manual-entry dedup matcher (app/server/listings/dedup.ts), and the write rate limiter (app/server/rate-limit). ignoreStatic is ON (AUB-201): static mutants — mutations in module-level initialization, where perTest coverage can't apply so EACH ONE re-runs the whole suite — were, per Stryker's own MutantTestPlanner warning on the CI run that prompted this, 60 mutants (13%) consuming an estimated ~92% of the runtime (the local re-measure below counted 56 static of 454 generated); ignoring them cut the run from tens of minutes to ~5m22s. TRADE-OFF: static mutants are now UNSCORED, so this gate no longer exercises module-level constants (e.g. RECENT_INCIDENT_WINDOW_DAYS, DEFAULT_STALENESS_MONTHS, DEFAULT_WRITE_RATE_LIMIT, the CLAIM_ATTRIBUTE_* maps). The highest-stakes ones stay pinned by ordinary hardcoded-literal tests that Stryker never ran for them anyway: the 90-day incident window (trust-model.invariant.test.ts), the rate-limit config (rate-limit/index.test.ts toEqual({limit:50,windowMs:60_000})), and staleness-window growth (summary.test.ts's literal 7-month check); a shrink of DEFAULT_STALENESS_MONTHS to 3-5 is the one unpinned direction, accepted because it fails SAFE (flags staleness earlier, never later). Ignored static mutants leave the score's denominator, so the baseline was RE-MEASURED with ignoreStatic on: total mutation score 84.62% across 403 runtime mutants (summary 97.04, browse-glance 96.77, browse-card-format 95.24, rate-limit 84.21, dedup 71.88, incident-recency 62.50 — the last dragged down by Zod error-message string literals and TZ paths the DB-free suite can't fairly kill). thresholds.break is 84 (rounded DOWN from 84.62) so it PASSES today on a green main and can be ratcheted up as tests improve — it is intentionally NOT set above the measured score, which would false-fail a green main. To raise the floor, add tests that kill surviving mutants (see reports/mutation/mutation.html) and bump break.
